name: Local & Home Services

datasets.title: Business details
datasets.why: What the plug-in says about the business and where customers can reach it.

columns.label: Summary
columns.example: Handy Helpers serves customers in and around Charlotte, NC.
columns.help: One or two sentences, in the business's own words.

columns.label: Public email
columns.help: The address customers may write to.

columns.label: What you are
columns.help: A few words shown after your name in ChatGPT, e.g. "Harbor Street Studio – Yoga in Charlotte". Without it, the plug-in's industry is shown.

columns.label: Logo URL
columns.help: Your own logo as an https image, square if you have one. Shown next to your plug-in in the BizPlug portal, and as its icon in ChatGPT.

columns.label: Wide logo URL
columns.help: Optional: your logo with your name, wider than it is tall, as an https PNG, JPEG or WebP image. From plug-in version 0.25.0 it heads your card in ChatGPT and Claude; without it the card shows the logo above.

columns.label: Currency
columns.help: ISO code for the prices in the other files.

columns.label: Requests go to
columns.help: The team inbox that should receive requests from ChatGPT (not shown to customers).

collect: Copy the name, summary, phone, email, website and address exactly as they appear on the business's website or Google Business Profile.
Write the summary in the business's own words (one or two sentences). Do not add claims the business does not make.
Ask the owner which inbox should receive requests from ChatGPT and put it in notify_email.

datasets.title: Price list (home services)
datasets.why: The published prices the plug-in builds estimates from. Estimates are never final prices.

columns.label: Unit
columns.help: What one unit is (room, sq ft, hour, item).

collect: Copy the published price list or rate card. Only include prices the business is happy to publish as estimates.

datasets.title: Services list
datasets.why: A short list of what the business offers, used in answers.
collect: List the services from the website's services or about page, one per row, short names only.

datasets.title: Questions and answers
datasets.why: The plug-in answers customer questions only from these, so it never guesses.

columns.label: Question
columns.help: How a customer would ask it.

columns.label: Answer
columns.help: The business's answer, in full sentences.

collect: Take the FAQ page of the website first, then policies (cancellation, delivery, payment, parking, accessibility).
Keep each answer factual and current. Leave out anything the owner has not confirmed.

never: Passwords, API keys or other secrets.
Card numbers, bank details or government ID numbers.
Customers' personal data (names, phone numbers, addresses, health or financial details).
